mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 79 degrees under clear skies at the Verona Area High School. We are currently under a Waning Gibbous moon phase. Tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 63 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has announced that they are now managing the local cemetery on North Main Street, allowing anyone to purchase a plot through their online application process. Additionally, the city is encouraging residents to install rain barrels to help manage stormwater, offering a 30 dollar rebate for qualifying barrels.

We have a busy schedule starting today with Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company or Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Downtown Farmer's Market and more live music later in the week.

On July 31, a police officer stopped a vehicle for lacking taillights and driving on a flat tire, resulting in the driver being arrested for an O W I, alongside additional citations for suspended registration.
Stop by Culver's of Verona today to enjoy the Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor of the day; they are open until 10 PM tonight.
